changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0077. Let a business keep its own custom roles without a second permission catalog. System roles stay global templates. Index review: drop UX_Roles_Name because a custom role may reuse a display name inside one tenant; UX_Roles_SystemName keeps system names unique; UX_Roles_Tenant_Name keeps a tenant from creating two active roles with the same name; IX_Roles_TenantId supports listing that tenant's roles; PK_RoleResourceScopes is the role-and-resource lookup used when a member query applies All, Assigned, or Own. Performance note: role lists are one tenant's templates plus its custom rows, and scope checks are a point lookup by role.
